title: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from
question: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from any movie release year present in the data had the largest number of films, considering consecutive ten-year periods beginning at each unique year? Only output the start year and the total count for that specific period.

prediction.sql:
WITH valid_years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(year AS INTEGER) AS y
  FROM Movie
  WHERE year GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
),
periods AS (
  SELECT s.y AS start_year, COUNT(m.MID) AS cnt
  FROM valid_years s
  JOIN Movie m
    ON m.year GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
   AND CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) >= s.y
   AND CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) < s.y + 10
  GROUP BY s.y
)
SELECT start_year, cnt
FROM periods
ORDER BY cnt DESC, start_year ASC
LIMIT 1;
